scope: Quasi-static same-material union mass plus E harness. Material, friction and printed allowable conditions are unmeasured. No impact, fatigue or 100-cycle qualification.
assumptions: Custom shafts require certified minimum yield 750 MPa after machining; lumbar flexion requires 940 MPa. Ordinary annealed 304 rods do not meet these requirements.
Printed allowable 8 MPa and modulus 1500 MPa are design assumptions, not filament qualification.

Dry steel friction >=0.08, printed allowable 8 MPa, and stated certified shaft/plate/cap materials required. Capture bolt uses ISO4762 class10.9, not an old roll-pin rating. W is T6 double axis, not S1 ball joint.
mass_basis: Boolean-unioned same-material production bodies, separate purchased hardware; no double counting of fused primitives
